title.narrative: Enhanced constituents' capacity to ensure compliance with fundamental principles and rights at work

description.narrative: Since 2020, the Cairo office has been engaged with the "Strengthening Labour Relation and its Institution" Project, aiming to enhance compliance with international labour standards, expand the Better Work Programme, promote Freedom of Association, eradicate child labor, and establish social dialogue on FPRW and OSH. During this biennium, the focus will be on enduring interventions in social partnerships and dialogue. In early 2022, a draft decree aimed at improving the High Council for Social Dialogue was approved by the Ministry of Manpower and forwarded to the Prime Minister. Nevertheless, there are still uncertainties regarding the High Council's financial independence, the branches of HCSD in governorates, and the representation of workers
